items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: there with a troupe or show called Nat Reece Carnival. Her and her brother and family and we took her away from Nat Reece and she went...uh...came to us, and we featured her for a coupla years with our show called Spikes Brothers'...uh,

ctx.x: Oh, I don't remember. We bought uniforms--sent off and got uniforms from the uniform stores, you know. I think some of them--some of the uniforms was khaki. You know, soldiers' khaki and thing...but it's been so long that... I had a picture of them--the whole band and everything--but I can't find where they are. I got a lot of junk stored away in the basement but I guess it's all down there. Even when I was drafted in Honolulu to go in the Army in the big band there was...I'm a saxophone player and clarinet…
